index.name: Kedenburg et al., Opt. Mater. Express 2, 1588 (2012), 20 C
index.source: S. Kedenburg et al., Opt. Mater. Express 2, 1588 (2012) (refractiveindex.info main/CS2/Kedenburg); one-pole fit valid 0.5-1.6 um, extrapolated outside

n2.source: total n2 for ps pulses (electronic + orientational); typical value, the literature spread is a factor 2-3; not re-checked

ramanFraction.source: orientational (delayed) share of the total n2; the electronic part 3e-19 m^2/W is the fs value quoted by Liu et al., Opt. Lett. 38, 1838 (2013) citing Ganeev 2004; not re-checked
